name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 56 – Am 65
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 56a. Believes that the EU emissions trading system (ETS) has contributed to the collapse of European industry by imposing disproportionately high production costs on European companies; calls for the immediate suspension of the EU ETS and calls for work to begin on the complete withdrawal of the EU ETS regulations;
